method.class: selection-aware score reporting for prompt/pipeline search: post-hoc estimators and 90% intervals for the fresh-question accuracy of a configuration selected on a finite benchmark sample, using only the search-time evaluation log
method.description: Candidate handle(request) implements reset{seed} and report{...}; a report receives the base64-encoded evaluation log (question_idx uint16, config_idx uint8, outcome uint8), the selected config, N, K, searcher tag and anonymized subject codes of one search replication and returns {estimate, lower, upper} for the selected config's accuracy on fresh questions. Evaluator-owned worlds: synthetic latent-difficulty worlds with exact truth and cached real MMLU-Pro outcomes of Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct under 24 prompt configs; evaluator-owned exhaustive and successive-halving searchers; negative controls N1 (synthetic null), N2 (real permuted-config null, vacuity-checked), Z1 (constant zero world). Score: negative mean interval score at level 0.90 aggregated replication -> episode -> case -> family -> plane (0.4 synthetic, 0.6 real); failed replications/episodes keep the worst case IS=20 without renormalization. Conditional claim only: this model/benchmark/prompt family, these two searchers, no DSPy/MIPRO, no adaptive Ladder-style reporting.

entrypoints: data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet (12,032 questions) and data/validation-00000-of-00001.parquet (70 demonstration questions): fields question, options, answer, category; used only at draft time to build the shipped outcome tensors

model weights and tokenizer, shared immutable upstream asset (not held-out data); used only at draft time to score every pool question under 24 prompt configurations on CPU, fp32, one forward pass, argmax over option-letter logits

protocol.promotion_rule: Search correct predicate (separate from any final claim): all 28 declared episodes reset exactly once in declared order; exact finite declared metrics; negative controls non-vacuous (N2 derangement + spread collapse, naive bias on N1 and N2 significantly positive) and Z1 constant-world integrity (mean |estimate| <= 0.05, truth covered >= 90%); no RPC/deadline violation. Invalid replications keep worst-case contributions and do not veto. No comparative performance threshold. The harness ranks eligible candidates by combined_score (higher is better), freezes the top one before final resources are opened, then runs the sealed final evaluation; the final claim (supported/refuted/conditional per family, N and searcher) is assessed from seed-level paired differences versus the three baselines and is never a search veto.

search_proxies.name: search_small_real_pool
search_proxies.preserves: selection-after-search mechanism on real LLM outcomes (N=200, K=24, exhaustive and successive halving), replication-level truth on held-out pool questions, null/constant controls
search_proxies.omits: final-only sample sizes N=60 and N=600, the larger final pool, and the 8 final seeds (search uses 4 seeds and a 600-question pool)

search_proxies.name: cpu_cached_small_llm_tensor
search_proxies.preserves: real MMLU-Pro questions and a real instruction-tuned LLM's per-question correctness under 24 prompt configurations
search_proxies.omits: 7-8B scale models and GPU scoring; outcomes were scored once at draft time with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on CPU, so config accuracy levels are low and finite-pool truth has about 2 point SE

search_proxies.name: synthetic_latent_difficulty_worlds
search_proxies.preserves: exact analytic truth, correlated outcomes across configs, planted spread vs null
search_proxies.omits: real prompt-family structure; a single fixed generator family with K=32 and N=150

search_visible: search-plane metrics.json scalars (combined_score, coverage, mean_width, signed_bias, rmse, baseline scores, naive_signed_bias, control metrics, completed_replication_fraction)
bounded episode failure categories on stderr and candidate stderr in drafting/qualification search runs
documented request/response schema in the starter program docstring
final_sealed: final seeds, final reset sequence and seed-to-episode mapping
final pool membership, manifest, outcome tensor, truth and per-replication candidate outputs
all final-plane metrics.json values and evidence until publication
final claim assessment details and final-plane control diagnostics

required_evidence: Raw-document disjointness: normalization (NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse), SHA-256 content hashes and source ids showing zero overlap between search pool, final pool and demonstration (validation) source, recorded in both resource manifests
Payload preflight: serialized largest planned request (N=1000, K=64 log) and response in UTF-8 JSON bytes with base64 expansion, all strictly below 64 MiB (checked in each evaluator run)
Reset-transcript evidence: exactly the declared search and final sequences, one reset per episode, no replay
Real-LLM provenance: pinned model repository/revision, MMLU-Pro revision, prompt-config definitions in the manifests, CPU compute used to build the tensors
Smoke result on the reduced path labelled as not attesting full production completion
Search results, eligibility decisions, ranking trace and the frozen candidate hash recorded before final resources are opened

Final results for the frozen candidate versus naive, Bonferroni-Wilson and resample baselines with seed-level uncertainty, reporting gap, coverage and width as functions of N (real family only), searcher and config spread (null vs non-null); K is fixed within each family and confounded with world type, so no K effect is claimed
Negative-control results N1, N2, Z1 with non-vacuity checks; a vacuous control is invalid evidence, not a causal conclusion
Worst-case handling record: counts of invalid/timed-out/missing replications and episodes with no renormalization

Limitations: single small model and benchmark, finite-pool truth noise, fixed searchers, no DSPy/MIPRO run, no adaptive Ladder-style reporting, conclusion-flip analysis limited to coverage and null-world false-improvement rates
